title: Detailed pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bladeGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f4ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#b8d8f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8ab8d8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handleGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc3333'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handleGrad2' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8888'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#dd4444'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pivotGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc9900'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Left blade -->
  <polygon points='50,45 48,44 15,10 12,8 18,14 44,46' fill='url(#bladeGrad)' stroke='#6aa8cc' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='44,46 18,14 14,12 20,16 42,44' fill='#d0e8f8'/>

  <!-- Right blade -->
  <polygon points='50,45 52,44 85,10 88,8 82,14 56,46' fill='url(#bladeGrad)' stroke='#6aa8cc' stroke-width='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='56,46 82,14 86,12 80,16 58,44' fill='#d0e8f8'/>

  <!-- Blade edges left -->
  <line x1='17' y1='12' x2='47' y2='43' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='19' y1='14' x2='46' y2='42' stroke='#e0f0ff' stroke-width='0.4'/>

  <!-- Blade edges right -->
  <line x1='83' y1='12' x2='53' y2='43' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='81' y1='14' x2='54' y2='42' stroke='#e0f0ff' stroke-width='0.4'/>

  <!-- Blade tip highlights -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='11' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='11' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Left handle -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='78' rx='14' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='url(#handleGrad)' stroke-width='6'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='78' rx='14' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ff9999' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-dasharray='4,3' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Right handle -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='78' rx='14' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='url(#handleGrad2)' stroke-width='6'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='78' rx='14' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ffaaaa' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-dasharray='4,3' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Handle connectors left -->
  <polygon points='44,48 38,62 30,62 36,48' fill='#ee5555' stroke='#cc3333' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <polygon points='44,48 38,62 36,60 42,46' fill='#ff7777'/>

  <!-- Handle connectors right -->
  <polygon points='56,48 62,62 70,62 64,48' fill='#ee5555' stroke='#cc3333' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <polygon points='56,48 62,62 64,60 58,46' fill='#ff7777'/>

  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='5' fill='url(#pivotGrad)' stroke='#aa7700' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#ffe888' stroke='#cc9900' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <!-- Screw cross -->
  <line x1='48' y1='45' x2='52' y2='45' stroke='#aa7700' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='43' x2='50' y2='47' stroke='#aa7700' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Screw shine -->
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='43.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Extra blade detail lines -->
  <line x1='22' y1='17' x2='40' y2='38' stroke='#a0c8e0' stroke-width='0.5' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='17' x2='60' y2='38' stroke='#a0c8e0' stroke-width='0.5' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>

  <!-- Handle inner highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='75' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ffbbbb' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='75' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ffbbbb' opacity='0.4'/>
</svg>
